mapper.select: select name, count(id) as num from dc group by state

SELECT count( DISTINCT aa.id ) AS alarm, aa.pid AS pid, aa.id AS asset FROM asset_asset aa LEFT JOIN asset_ping ap ON aa.manage_ip = ap.host LEFT JOIN alert_message_active am ON aa.id = am.asset_id WHERE ( ap.`status` = 0 OR ap.STATUS IS NULL OR am.state = 1 ) GROUP BY aa.id;

select aa.dc_id id, count(DISTINCT aa.id) alarm from asset_asset aa left join asset_ping ap on aa.id = ap.asset_id left join asset_state_conf assc on aa.state_id = assc.id left join alert_message_active ama on aa.id = ama.asset_id where ((ap.`status`=0 or ap.`status` is null) or ama.state=1) and assc.ping=1 group by aa.dc_id

select dc.id id, count(*) total, sum(case when mes.state=1 then 1 else 0 end) ok from monitor_endpoint me left join monitor_endpoint_state mes on me.id = mes.endpoint_id left join asset_asset aa on aa.id = me.asset_id left join asset_ping ap on aa.id = ap.asset_id left join dc on dc.id = aa.dc_id group by dc.id
SELECT count(*) total, am.dc_id id, ascc.name name FROM alert_message_active am LEFT JOIN alert_severity_conf ascc ON am.severity_id = ascc.id WHERE am.dc_id >= 1 GROUP BY am.dc_id, am.severity_id
select dc.id, count(*) total, sum(case when ps.status=1 then 1 else 0 end) ok from prom_server ps left join dc on dc.id = ps.dc_id group by ps.dc_id
